Question: How many health and beauty items were sold in delivered orders?
text:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS health_beauty_items_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pcnt 
     ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND pcnt.product_category_name_english LIKE '%Health%Beauty%';
```
Counts all order items whose product belongs to a “Health & Beauty” category and whose orders have a status of delivered.
